rationale: C01 is a highly plausible direct drafting template. It is an earlier letter from the same administration addressing another International Longshoremen's Association strike at Atlantic and Gulf ports. The child reproduces C01's full operative sequence and extensive near-verbatim language: invocation of section 206, creation of a Board of Inquiry, the same four-part description of maritime employers, receipt of the Board's report, the statutory national-health-and-safety finding, and direction under section 208 to seek an injunction and other appropriate relief. C14 and C25 share much of this machinery, but C01 is closest in geographic scope, represented employees, phrasing, and administrative context.

shared_material.child_excerpt: labor disputes between employers ... who are (1) steamship companies or who are engaged as operators or agents for ships engaged in service from or to Atlantic and Gulf Coast ports ... (2) contracting stevedores, (3) contracting marine carpenters, or (4) other employers engaged in related or associated pier activities
shared_material.parent_excerpt: labor disputes between employers ... who are (1) steamship companies or who are engaged as operators or agents for ships engaged in service from or to Atlantic and Gulf ports ... (2) contracting stevedores, (3) contracting marine carpenters, or (4) other employers engaged in related or associated pier activities
shared_material.explanation: Distinctive, detailed, and nearly verbatim identification of the same maritime employer classes and operating region.

shared_material.child_excerpt: In my opinion these unresolved labor disputes have resulted in a strike affecting a substantial part of an industry engaged in trade, commerce, transportation, transmission or communication among the several States and with foreign nations, which strike, if permitted to continue, will imperil the national health and safety
shared_material.parent_excerpt: In my opinion these unresolved labor disputes have resulted in a strike affecting an entire industry or a substantial part thereof engaged in trade, commerce, transportation, transmission or communication among the several States and with foreign nations which strike, if permitted to continue, will imperil the national health and safety.
shared_material.explanation: Near-verbatim statutory finding occupying the same position after receipt of the Board's report.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I direct you, pursuant to the provisions of Section 208 ... to petition in the name of the United States any District Court ... to enjoin the continuance of such strike and for such other relief as may in your judgment be necessary or appropriate.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I therefore direct you, pursuant to the provisions of Section 208 ... to petition in the name of the United States any District Court ... to enjoin the continuance of such strike ... and for such other relief as may in your judgment be necessary or appropriate.
shared_material.explanation: The same operative injunction instruction, using the same statutory authority, court mechanism, requested remedy, and discretionary-relief clause.
